notes.title: Alpha 2 Patch 2 - Update Unhinged!
notes.content:
[p]With the early playtest coming to a close soon, we’ve decided to get a little unhinged and give all of y’all access to some of the creative tools we’ve had in the game that have allowed us to create the wondrous landscape for you folk to traipse around in. You’ll find these tools now craftable at your crafting bench. We’ve also added quite a few decorative items that were previously unavailable to give people more power during our ongoing [u][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2997840"]Isle of Imagination Creative Contest[/url][/u].[/p][p]
[b][i]Please note: anybody who has access to your island can use these tools, do not invite friends with a penchant for mischief if you don’t want them to do mischief![/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]A full list of changes live with this patch can be found below: [/p][list][*][p]Various creative tools are now available in the crafting bench[/p][list][*][p]Bulldozer (flatten terrain underneath your mech)[/p][/*][*][p]Ramper (add terrain underneath your mech)[/p][/*][*][p]Terrain Paintbrushes (grass, grass without cover, dirt, stone, sand)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added tutorials for these wonderful new creative tools[/p][/*][*][p]New crops now available to players (after Sam expands the shop), including...[/p][list][*][p]Strawberries[/p][/*][*][p]Turnips[/p][/*][*][p]Pumpkins[/p][/*][*][p]Carrots[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New flowers now available to players (after Sam expands the shop), including...[/p][list][*][p]Meowgentas[/p][/*][*][p]Grrr-aniums[/p][/*][*][p]Duckfadils[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New beach-style furniture available to players (because who wouldn't like to be at the beach right now), including...[/p][list][*][p]Beach Ball[/p][/*][*][p]Beach Chair[/p][/*][*][p]Beach Cooler[/p][/*][*][p]Beach Lounge Chair[/p][/*][*][p]Beach Towel[/p][/*][*][p]Beach Table[/p][/*][*][p]Lifeguard Tower[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Other decorations that can make any home feel like, well home....[/p][list][*][p]Flower Pots (3)[/p][/*][*][p]Fountains (2)[/p][/*][*][p]Pedestals (3)[/p][/*][*][p]Fences[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Radial menu for equipment is now a full circle with more slots (10 in total, so many!)[/p][/*][*][p]Various bug fixes, including...[/p][list][*][p]Fixed old doobers (shop, portal recipe)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the scaling on the zen-style furniture[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory UI causing actions to trigger behind it[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaning up display names and descriptions[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Many objects and items in the game are now editable using the Design Tool (even Redwood trees), feel free to take things home with you![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Alpha 2 Patch 1
notes.content: [p]We just want to say thank you to everyone playing Animalkind, we’re super pumped you showed up for our first week of our Alpha 2 playtest! Your feedback and bug reports have been immensely helpful to us. We wanted to update the playtest as quickly as we could to address common issues and also incorporate feedback we've received. We hope you enjoy this latest update![/p][p][/p][p]NPCs[/p][list][*][p]NPCs can now walk on wooden platforms, allowing you to guide them away from small islands or tall mountain tops[/p][/*][/list][p]Decoration Mode[/p][list][*][p]Being in decoration mode for a house when someone else picks it up no longer soft locks the game[/p][/*][*][p]Changing Wall Colors now persists correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixing some sizes of furniture items that were too small[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the yellow house[/p][/*][/list][p]World Environment[/p][list][*][p]Fixing invisible trees[/p][/*][*][p]Crops no longer duplicate when you load back into the world[/p][/*][/list][p]Player[/p][list][*][p]Rocket Boost no longer causes you to have infinite energy[/p][/*][*][p]Dropped item stacks no longer duplicate[/p][/*][*][p]Fixing items flickering as a player holds them while doing an emote[/p][/*][*][p]Fixing clipping through the water plane[/p][/*][/list][p]Quests[/p][list][*][p]Fixing some quest tracking problems[/p][/*][/list][p]Content[/p][list][*][p]Home island now contains FLOOF Codex fragments[/p][/*][*][p]The flimsy fishing rod now has a small chance of catching tuna; aim for the swirling water for better odds[/p][/*][*][p]Copper now respawns in 10 minutes[/p][/*][*][p]Copper and iron deposits now drop 50% more ore[/p][/*][*][p]Redwoods now drop hardwood if you chop them down (but the fir trees are good too)[/p][/*][*][p]The shop recipe can now be bought unlimited times[/p][/*][*][p]The shop can now be crafted unlimited times[/p][/*][*][p]The wilderness NPCs now have designated spawn points on the home island so they won't end up on hills[/p][/*][*][p]Sturdy and Advanced tools have increased durability[/p][/*][*][p]Rosie's daily quests have been fixed, you can now turn them in[/p][/*][*][p]Some broken recipes were fixed from the portal shop[/p][/*][*][p]Barney is a bit better about telling players about the mushroom stew recipe[/p][/*][*][p]Some plants have been renamed[/p][/*][*][p]We went and touched up some dialog for funsies and clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Some typos were fixed (and hopefully no new ones added)[/p][/*][/list][p]Inputs[/p][list][*][p]Switched to using the OS mouse - meaning the sensitivity should match whatever you have set for your OS.[/p][/*][*][p]Controller support in main menu - still a work in progress, but no longer requires the virtual mouse[/p][/*][*][p]Touch screen support in main menu[/p][/*][/list]
